LESSON: WRITING 4.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing, part of Strand 4 in Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why are proverbs and sayings important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to put together a collection of proverbs and sayings from the community,

2. team up to list the proverbs and sayings on sentence strips for display,

3. organise their collection of proverbs and sayings in a group portfolio,

4. engage in a language game to find meaning of community proverbs and sayings,

5. write a composition on the theme using proverbs and sayings

6. share their compositions with peers for peer review,

7. publish the best compositions in a class reading club.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to put together a collection of proverbs and sayings from the community,
2. team up to list the proverbs and sayings on sentence strips for display,
3. organise their collection of proverbs and sayings in a group portfolio,
4. engage in a language game to find meaning of community proverbs and sayings,
5. write a composition on the theme using proverbs and sayings
6. share their compositions with peers for peer review,
7. publish the best compositions in a class reading club.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: This is enhanced as the learner analyses concepts when engaging in language

games to find meaning of community proverbs and sayings.

24

• Creativity and Imagination: This is enhanced as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creativity when writing

compositions on the theme using proverbs and sayings.

Values:
Love: This is enhanced as the learner portrays a caring attitude when sharing their compositions with peers for constructive

feedback.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Good governance: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates and obeys the school rules.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of sayings and proverbs to their learning in English and Kiswahili.
